title: All 1500 per-tick hashes invalidated while run parameters are unchanged — the golden provides no anchor to verify the intended behavior change
detail: Every one of the 1500 tick hashes changed while seed, logic_hz, and tick count are untouched context lines. Either the change alters global simulation state or the golden was wholesale-regenerated; the diff cannot distinguish intended from accidental change.
recommended_fix: Commit a text summary stating which tick ranges changed and why (expected vs incidental). If regeneration was mechanical, say so in the commit message.

title: Binary goldens changed with zero visible content — the warning-log change is unreviewable
evidence:
Binary files a/goldens/warn.log.bin and b/goldens/warn.log.bin differ
Binary files a/goldens/warn/65000ms.png and b/goldens/warn/65000ms.png differ
detail: warn.log.bin presumably captures the warning stream. A binary-only diff hides whether warnings grew, shrank, or changed in content, and the PNG frame is equally opaque to review.
recommended_fix: Generate a text sidecar (warning count, per-tick warning hashes) and commit its diff alongside the binaries; document why the 65000ms frame changed.

title: catalog_hash and all 1500 tick hashes changed in lockstep — the golden cannot attribute tick changes to any specific behavior change
detail: If per-tick state hashes fold the catalog in, any catalog change avalanches every tick hash, so the golden loses its power to isolate which ticks' behavior actually changed in this PR.
recommended_fix: Separate catalog identity from per-tick state hashing, or publish a per-tick diff summary marking ticks whose state changed independent of the catalog.
